policy_authority: Explicit server-local constructor configuration; no caller policy, account, price or approval fields.
amounts: Canonical unsigned minor-unit strings validated with the existing money primitives; totals grouped by currency without conversion.
revalidation: Re-read current scope, order, package, address, account, policy and rate. Only still-eligible rows contribute to totals. A blocked or stale row requires a new quote to become eligible.
snapshot_integrity: A process-local HMAC covers the whole returned snapshot. Editing membership, prices, totals or claims invalidates it. Restart discards the key and requires a new quote. It authenticates no merchant, carrier, human approval or external observation.
storage: No new database tables, files or durable quote registry. Synthetic source maps and the integrity key live only in memory. Returned snapshots contain opaque source/address references; caller retention is outside this component.
